text:
eva_s: alert: secret-scanner just flagged two long-lived AWS access keys embedded inside a model checkpoint stored at s3://ml-checkpoints/train-job-4321/checkpoint-2026-03-22.tar.gz. Keys appear in the checkpoint metadata 'saved_env'.

mike_infra: please confirm bucket/prefix and AccessKey IDs so we can revoke.

eva_s: confirmed path above. Scanner excerpt: 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAEXAMPLE1' and 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAEXAMPLE2' in metadata/manifest.json inside the tar.

tara_data: I can reproduce with local scanner rule. Looks like the trainer VM exported ENV vars into checkpoint during save.

sam_prod: any outward exposure? public access?

eva_s: bucket is not public; access is restricted but keys are long-lived and used by CI jobs. Treat P0 for rotation & CI remediation.

mike_infra: taking actions now: 1) revoke exposed keys 2) rotate CI tokens that used them 3) kick impacted CI runs 4) scan other checkpoints for similar leaks

security-bot: [automated] New issue created: S-5312 "Rotate leaked trainer IAM keys + artifact sweep" assigned to infra, priority P0.

deploy-bot: [automated] Queued full repo & bucket sweep for AKIA patterns. ETA ~40m.

eva_s: immediate mitigation checklist:
- mike_infra: revoke keys, add explicit deny policy for user/trainer-ec2 to write to /ml-checkpoints/* and create short-lived role for training via STS
- tara_data: update trainer to stop exporting AWS env vars into checkpoints, use AssumeRole or Secrets Manager instead
- sam_prod: rotate any CI credentials and restart pipelines that referenced the keys
- all: run './tools/secret-scanner --path s3://ml-checkpoints --pattern AKIA' and grep your artifacts for 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'

mike_infra: revocation started. Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/trainer-ec2. Keys AKIAEXAMPLE1 / AKIAEXAMPLE2. Created temp role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/trainer-temp with sts:AssumeRole and scoped S3 PutObject perms to ml-checkpoints/retries only. Added deny-inline to trainer-ec2 for checkpoint writes.

tara_data: pushed PR to remove ENV exports and use boto3 default session + role: https://github.com/redwood/ml-trainer/pull/278. Planning re-run with sanitized checkpoint.

sam_prod: rotated CI tokens and restarted jobs that referenced the old keys. No production call anomalies observed so far.

security-bot: [automated] Quick scan results: 6 repo matches in dev forks; creating follow-ups.

eva_s: compliance ask: Tara, provide list of training run IDs that wrote to that prefix between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-22. We'll need them for artifact review.

tara_data: pulling logs now, will post run IDs shortly.

mike_infra: short team checklist to share: rotate matching keys, sanitize & re-upload artifacts, stop writing secrets into model metadata, prefer STS roles or Secrets Manager, add lifecycle/or object-lock safeguards on buckets.

tara_data: run IDs: run-20260305-18, run-20260312-07, run-20260320-03. I'll attach sanitized manifests to S-5312 and mark which checkpoints need replacement.

eva_s: drafting sec advisory and timeline: 24h for rotation (in progress), 72h artifact sweep, 7d postmortem expected. Postmortem will be owned by training infra.

mike_infra: updating S-5312 with mitigation status, will close after CI green and artifact replacements confirmed.

security-bot: [automated] Full bucket sweep completed: 0 public objects, 12 private artifacts flagged for manual review. Refer to S-5312 for details.

eva_s: wrapping this thread. Follow-ups in S-5312. If you find other leaked keys, DM me and tag @security. :warning:

mike_infra: mitigation applied: keys revoked, deny policy added, temp role in use, CI tokens rotated. Continue scans and report anomalies. :lock:
